newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippines hands over APEC leadership to Canada.
newsitem.headline: Philippines hands over APEC leadership to Canada.

text.p: The Philippines on Tuesday handed over chairmanship of the 18-member Asia Pacific Economic Cooperation (APEC) forum to Canada.

"On behalf of the Philippines, I turn over to Canada the mantle of leadership of APEC .. with our assurances of full cooperation and active support to maintain its momentum," President Fidel Ramos said at a ceremony at the Malacanang presidential palace attended by Canadian Prime Minister Jean Chretien.

"For me to succeed you as the chair of APEC will be a big challenge," Chretien said in reply. "Because your year as the president has been an extremely successful one and you have put APEC on a much more pracitical basis in involving the business community very deeply in the operation."
"Government can take actions, but if we are not followed by an active business community ... the opportunities will go nowhere," he added.
Canada is to host the next summit of APEC leaders in Vancouver in November. The trade grouping held its last summit in the Philippines in November 1996.
Chretien arrived in Manila earlier on Tuesday on a three day visit accompanied by a 350-member business delegation.
